review_scope: G2 software-only review of frozen PA target topology and visibility watchdog/service ownership scripts. No Vitis, XSDB, UART, or hardware run was performed.

findings.location: sampling loop at lines 55-100; failure predicate at line 110; cleanup gate at lines 111-125; final watchdog record at lines 127-133
findings.title: A fast SDK failure can finish between samples and be reported as watchdog success without entry receipt or cleanup
findings.basis: The failure predicate treats SDK exit as failure only when an SDK process was captured and its exit code is nonzero. If the Python entry exits before the first one-second process sample, taskSdkProcess, taskSdkExit, and taskSdkIdentity remain null. The official Vitis batch can also return zero despite its synchronous Python child returning nonzero, so launcher exit zero does not close that gap.
findings.impact: A failed visibility probe that produced no visibility_probe_result.json can be recorded as native_exit_code 0; the owned hw_server is left open and a success-looking outer run record is emitted.
findings.required_closure: Require a present, parseable final entry result receipt bound to this exact run/config/source regardless of whether the SDK process was sampled. Require its successful status and native_exit_code 0 plus successful cleanup/result fields. If an SDK identity was sampled but no exit code was observed, fail and perform bounded identity-checked SDK/server cleanup. Missing, malformed, mismatched, or failed receipt must fail and trigger bounded cleanup.

pa_topology_and_public_dynamic_selection.basis: 10 focused offline tests passed. The production code retains exact four-or-six row topology validation, rejects unknown rows, uses actual CPU parent contexts for both PA nodes, verifies each PA context equals its CPU context plus .pa, and reselects the current FPGA ID with the public Session.targets(id=...) selector while validating the SDK display parent and level.

starter_and_closer_identity_checks.basis: Starter pins hw_server image/path, parent, listener ownership, and exact command-line variants; identity receipt stores CommandLine. Closer checks path, command line, parent, creation time, image hash, and exclusive listener before Stop-Process, and refuses on command-line drift. All three PowerShell files parse with zero errors.
starter_and_closer_identity_checks.limitation: No live server was started or stopped; these checks are static plus syntax-only in this review round.

watchdog_captured_sdk_still_live_after_l.basis: The synthetic watchdog mock can create this state, but the reviewed official Vitis source invokes python.exe directly at line 433 with no start/detach; the launcher remains alive while the child is observed. The synchronous property does not protect against a child that exits before the watchdog's first sample.

official_batch_child_exit_propagation.basis: A synchronous isolated batch mock with a child Python process that sleeps three seconds and exits 23 showed the child alive while cmd remained alive, but cmd exited 0 after the batch's goto :EOF. Thus batch synchrony is established while nonzero child exit propagation is not.

official_vitis_batch_evidence.interpretation: The Python child is synchronous in this official source path. The isolated mock confirms this but also demonstrates that the final batch exit code can be zero when the child exits 23.

successful_entry_receipt_fields_and_judg.source_lines: run result construction 506-508, success status assignment 576, cleanup/result finalization 586-617, CLI exit mapping 620-632

required_fields_for_probe_success.final_csr: present; final cold-idle observation returned by controller.cold_idle
required_fields_for_probe_success.uart_events: present; successful path requires epoch=0, last_sequence=2, abort_pending=null, failed=false
required_fields_for_probe_success.saved_files: present with SHA-256 and byte lengths for files that were actually saved

successful_entry_receipt_fields_and_judg.judgment_basis: The entry sets the pending-acceptance status only after the probe observations succeed, changes status to FAILED on exceptions or cleanup errors, derives native_exit_code as 2 for failure and 0 otherwise, and writes the final JSON in finally. This is a successful software probe receipt, not final G3/G4 hardware acceptance. The outer watchdog must bind this receipt to its configured run directory and source/config hashes; launcher exit zero alone is insufficient.

limitations: G2 software review only; no Vitis, XSDB, serial port, board, or hardware was operated.
The isolated Vitis batch mock is a local CMD/Python behavior reproduction, not execution of the proprietary Vitis runtime.

Initial unprivileged read-only test attempts failed due sandbox parent-path/WMI access restrictions; elevated reruns passed where applicable. Initial helper setup failures and Windows PowerShell 5.1 encoding/parser failures are preserved in raw_logs and are reviewer-environment issues, not production-source failures.
No production source or candidate script was modified.
